method: Observed CUA accessibility excerpts from the normal Debug app, synthetic three-turn chat; these are selected observations, not a full accessibility dump.

before.result: Selected text: QA first line; draft unchanged instead of a newline

Select middle in café 👩🏽‍💻 middle suffix, then Shift+Return

sourceScope: Normal-app checks used the 15:31 Xcode build of PromptComposer.swift with native Shift+Return and Enter submission. The subsequent refinement ignores Caps Lock/numeric-pad flags when classifying Return modifiers; the final hosted-control run additionally covers Caps Lock.
binaryIdentityLimit: The fixed launch metadata accidentally copied the earlier executable hash. That hash is excluded; the intermediate executable was overwritten by later builds. Build logs and the observed source/action sequence identify this run, but there is no verified archived binary hash for the intermediate normal-app check.
providerScope: Synthetic store deliberately has no daemon connection; the alert proves Enter reaches Send and retains the failed draft, not a completed live-provider turn.
